description: Lists the active services of one listed operator: service_id, name, description, duration in minutes, list price, after-hours price when the operator set one, and whether it is a mobile or request-only service. Provide exactly one of slug or operator_id.

slug.description: Operator slug, as returned by search_operators (for example "christiangflair").
